title: Implement IHAVE and TAKETHIS article ingestion handler
description:
Implement the NNTP peering session handler for inbound connections. Accept IHAVE <message-id>, check the Message-ID->CID map for duplicates (respond 435 if known), respond 335 to proceed, receive article, validate headers and size at ingress, respond 235 on success or 437/43x on failure. Same for TAKETHIS. Artifact: transit/src/peering/ingestion.rs.

Acceptance:
- 435 response for already-known Message-ID (no duplicate store)
- 437 response for malformed article (logged, not stored)
- Article size limit enforced (configurable, default 1MB for text-only v1)
- Message-ID format validated before use as map key
- Unit test: inject a valid article, a duplicate, and a malformed article; check response codes
